title: RL Electric Circuit Equation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: In an RL series circuit, L di/dt + R i = V_0 where V_0 is a constant voltage. If i(0) = 0, find current i(t).

steps.title: Solve Using Integrating Factor
steps.mathExpression: \mu(t) = e^{Rt/L} \implies \frac{d}{dt}[e^{Rt/L} i] = \frac{V_0}{L} e^{Rt/L} \implies e^{Rt/L} i = \frac{V_0}{R} e^{Rt/L} + C

steps.title: Apply i(0) = 0
steps.mathExpression: i(t) = \frac{V_0}{R} + C e^{-Rt/L}; \quad i(0) = 0 \implies C = -\frac{V_0}{R} \implies i(t) = \frac{V_0}{R}(1 - e^{-Rt/L})
